mapper.select: SELECT g.id AS goal_id, g.description AS description, g.domain AS domain, g.target_date AS target_date, p.student_id AS student_id, s.full_name AS student_name FROM iep_goals g JOIN iep_programs p ON p.id = g.iep_id JOIN students s ON s.id = p.student_id WHERE g.target_date IS NOT NULL AND g.target_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND p.student_id IN #{sid} ORDER BY g.target_date
